properties.name: Approximate ZIP 81008 extent
properties.description: Bounding box returned by Nominatim for ZIP code 81008; used as a rough frame for North Pueblo research.
properties.notes: Desktop mapping uses bounding box because public polygon data for the ZIP code is not accessible without shapefiles.

properties.name: Pueblo Police Department / Real-Time Crime Center
properties.description: Public Safety Complex that now hosts the Real-Time Crime Center, ShotSpotter feeds, Daktronics video wall, and Community Connect intake.

properties.name: Downtown Flock ALPR Installations
properties.description: Pueblo Downtown Association-funded Flock Safety cameras covering the Union Ave / Riverwalk corridors to alert police about stolen vehicles and hit-and-runs.
properties.notes: Exact pole locations are not published; map locates the Historic Arkansas Riverwalk/Union Ave business district referenced in KOAA reporting.

properties.name: Pueblo Mall private security office
properties.description: North-side retail hub with on-site security office, lost & found, and camera-friendly code of conduct inside ZIP 81008.
properties.notes: Represents one of the largest commercial lots feeding Community Connect sign-ups in ZIP 81008.

properties.name: Pueblo County Sheriff’s Office HQ
properties.description: 909 Court Street command campus where Sheriff Lucero issued the Jan. 2025 statement limiting cooperation with ICE round-ups.
properties.notes: Use for monitoring public statements, jail releases, and ICE coordination rumors.

properties.name: Catholic Charities Immigration Services
properties.description: Safe walk-in site at 429 W 10th St offering immigration legal aid, Know Your Rights briefings, and DocuTeam referrals.
properties.notes: Coordinate with staff before routing protest arrestees’ families here for documentation support.

properties.name: Mineral Palace Park community staging zone
properties.description: Parade and outreach site for Pueblo Pride and community safety events; open sight lines make it a safer rally point away from downtown RTCC clusters.
properties.notes: Use park perimeter for "green zone" medical tents and mutual aid drop-offs before marches head south.
